turns.text: Storage up 5%, Kitchen down 3%, and costs up 2% everywhere: what happens to gross profit, and what volume change in each category keeps it whole?

csvChecks.ask: category_scenario.csv with columns category,gp_change_gbp,breakeven_pct: one row per category and a row named total; gp_change_gbp the gross-profit change at 2025 volumes, breakeven_pct the % volume change in that category, in percent (so -11.8 means an 11.8% fall),, with its SKU mix held, that keeps its gross profit the same (blank for total)
